To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
mindfulness group therapy is effective for the treatment of depression, anxiety and adjustment disorders in a primary care setting.

1) mindfulness group therapy (MGT) is effective for the treatment of depression, anxiety, and stress and adjustment disorder; 2) MGT is more effective for the treatment for depression and stress and adjustment than a waiting list; 3) MGT is equally effective for the treatment depression, anxiety, stress and adjustment as cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT); 4) MGT has a similar effect size for depression, anxiety, distress, and adjustment as CBT, 5
the Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy (MBCT) is effective in reducing the symptoms of depression and anxiety, and in improving quality of life, in patients with recurrent depression.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how mindfulness-based interventions may be used in the context of psychotherapy.
how mindfulness can be applied in the context of mental health and wellbeing.
the study of mindfulness and the effects of mindfulness training on a range of outcomes, including mental health.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the evidence supports the use of mindfulness meditation for the treatment of depression and anxiety in patients with chronic illness.
mindfulness based therapy is an effective and beneficial treatment for a range of psychological and physical conditions and disorders.
mindfulness-based interventions (MBIs) are efficacious in the treatment of depression, stress, and anxiety in primary care settings, but that more research is needed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mindfulness group therapy (MGT) is an efficacious treatment for depression, stress, and anxiety in primary care patients.
mindfulness-based group therapy is an efficacious intervention for patients with depression, stress and/or anxiety in primary care.
mindfulness group therapy can be recommended as a treatment for primary care patients with a broad spectrum of psychiatric disorders.
